title: UI: Fix capturing information in the window title when switching profiles or saving prefs
description:
Add `updateTitlebar()` that sets the correct titlebar contents based
on system state (currently capturing or not).

Fixes #19311

commits_data.message:
UI: Fix capturing information in the title when prefs are saved

Add updateTitlebar() that sets the correct titlebar contents based
on system state (currently capturing or not). It prevents overwriting
the capture-specific information when updating the title bar.

Fixes #19311
